Shape the rules

Use comma-separated counts. 8 surrounding neighbors.

If a cell sees enough neighbors of the target element, it changes. First matching rule wins.

Lenia · One continuous state. A smooth neighborhood. A growth rule.

μ chooses where growth peaks. σ controls tolerance. R sets the reach of the neighborhood. Water and fire are visual themes.

Customize the Lenia kernel & growth

1–4 comma-separated weights in [0,1]. The radial kernel is normalized to sum to 1.

n = weighted neighborhood, m = μ, s = σ. Operators + − * / ^ and abs, min, max, exp, sin, cos.
A′ = clip(A + Δt × G(n), 0, 1). Clipping is part of Lenia.

Grid & initial conditions

Orbium and Rotorbium use reference organism seeds. The field preset uses a seeded patch; 3D uses a seeded volume.

Rule changes start a new experiment at T = 0.
